articleTitle: A New Optimization Method for Improving the Performance of Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: As the leading renewable energy source, solar energy is ideally suited for combating global warming. Solar systems in the form of photovoltaic (PV) generation strongly depend on their operating conditions in terms of techno-economic effectiveness. The partial shading (PS) environment, which results in significant power losses, exacerbates the difficulty of nonlinear control. High tracking and settling time, oscillations at global maxima (GM), and local maxima (LM) trapping under PS conditions are all apparent shortcomings of metaheuristics-based maximum power point tracking (MPPT) control systems. This research introduces a novel meta-heuristic technique based on MPPT control of PV systems called the Arithmetic Optimization Algorithm (AOA) technique. The proposed method enhances the performance of photovoltaic (PV) systems by permitting faster, more precise tracking and extremely low oscillations. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed AOA control method is notable for its ease of implementation, robustness, and steady-state power tracking efficiency of up to 99.643.

articleTitle: Real-Time Motion Up and Down Activity Recognition Based on Smart Phone and Smart Watch Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Human activity recognition has been active research in the last few years. It can be used effectively in different applications such as fitness, games, indoor localization, healthcare, and emergency notification. Lacking highly accurate motion up and down human activities recognition and using traditional motion sensors in such systems encourage us to design and implement human activities recognition systems based on motion and environment sensors. A Dataset consisting of 10 subjects has been used in this work. Only one machine learning classifier DT has been used to predict four motions up and down activities, including upstairs, downstairs, elevator up, and elevator down, based on accelerometer, gyroscope, GPS, and barometer sensors. Ration-based feature extraction based on statistical features has been used with PCA for feature selections. The proposed system shows consistent classification performance with up to 98% accuracy. Our work mainly contributes to using whether a sensor as a motion sensor or a traditional motion sensor to increase system performance.

articleTitle: A New Simple 7D Hyperchaotic System with Hidden Attractors and Electronic Circuit
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: A new 16-term simple 7D hyperchaotic system with three control parameters is constructed from a 5D hyperchaotic Yang system via nonlinear and linear state feedback strategies. The proposed system belongs to hidden attractors since it has no equilibria or an infinite number of equilibria points. With changing parameters, different behaviors are founded, such as hyperchaotic, hyperchaotic with 2-torus, and hyperchaotic with 3-torus. This system's dynamical analysis investigated numerically and theoretically, including divergence, equilibria points, Lyapunov exponents, phase portrait, coexisting attractors, Lyapunov dimension, and circuit realization. In addition, hybrid projective synchronization (HPS) has been done between the two identical 7-dimensional systems. This work is exceptionally new and straightforward compared to the known 7D hyperchaotic systems and satisfied Sprott's 3rd condition for publishing.

articleTitle: Simulating and Optimizing of Compact Modified Rectangular Shape Microstrip Antenna for UWB Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Ultra-wideband (UWB) is a communication technology introduced for short-range communication. This technology employs radio frequency waves to enable devices to interact with each other. In this paper, an altered rectangular microstrip antenna is introduced and designed for UWB applications. The microstrip line feed technique is applied to feed the simulated antenna to ensure the optimum impedance matching. The proposed antenna is simulated using the CST software's finite integration technique. The simulated antenna covers operating frequency bands in the range of 3.66 - 21.21 GHz with a return loss of less than -10dB in the operation band, and an antenna gain variates between 2.48 to 4.85dBi in the operation band..

articleTitle: Nonlinear Optical Properties of Ag/PMMA Nanocomposite Thin Films Deposited by Plasma Jet Polymerization
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: The ‘nonlinear’ optical ‘properties of silver/PMMA ‘nanocomposite ‘ thin films deposited on glass substrates' by in-situ aerosol-assisted plasma jet polymerization at atmospheric ‘pressure and comfortable ambient temperature from Methyl Meth Acrylate (MMA) monomer in the existence of silver nanoparticles were studied. We used five different concentricities of Ag’ nanoparticles,’ which were (3, 5, 7, 9, and 11'wt%). The Z-scan technique was used to 'measure the nonlinear optical properties with a second harmonic generation of pulsed Nd: YAG laser of wavelength 532nm, the energy of 30mJ, and pulse duration of 30ns. The results of open aperture Z-scan show increases in 'nonlinear ‘ absorption coefficient with silver concentricity increase, while the result of close aperture Z-scan samples show a positive nonlinear refractive index and self-focusing behavior.

articleTitle: Real Time Practical Face Recognition System of Distorted Images Using PCA
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Different homes and businesses require biometric identification, and security is one of the most important considerations. This paper aims to show how users may utilize face detection and recognition to improve the security of critical site entrances. The face is a multi-dimensional, complicated structure that requires advanced computers to detect and recognize. Face detection, identification, and automatic door access control are the three sections of this study. The Viola-Jones technique is used to detect the face, and the Principal Component Analysis (PCA) methodology is used to recognize it. The PCA method was chosen because of its quick identification time, low noise sensitivity, and ability to decrease facial picture dimensions without sacrificing key characteristics. There has been the development of a security system. After Matlab processing, HC-12 uses Arduino UNO (send and receive) controllers. A built-in camera is used to capture the individual's image first. The recorded image is then sent to a database created in MATLAB. The recorded image is compared to the training image in the database to determine the particular instance. Suppose the system detects the person as an authorized user. A signal is delivered to the Arduino UNO microcontroller via an HC-12 receiver as the former opens the gate or the door.

articleTitle: Study of Antenna/Rectenna Communication Network Energy Harvesting for Radio Frequency (RF) Based on Metamaterial Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Energy harvesting (EH), commonly called scavenging, is acquiring useful electricity from nearby natural or artificial energy sources. This article presents a literature evaluation of a 2-D thinner metamaterials-focused radio frequency energy scavenger for the Internet of Things (IoT). The study briefly introduces meta-surfaces before looking at the most recent developments for microwave power transmission and harvesting in this field. Several important variables have been highlighted that contribute to the efficacy of these meta-surface notions. This review also discusses meta-surfaces as adaptable, smart surfaces in wireless connections that simultaneously transfer information and energy. Last but not least, the paper analyzes existing difficulties and potential future opportunities, such as the potential use of ambiently charged programmable smart surfaces in the next generation of wireless communication to govern radio settings. The essential characteristics of the antenna (Rectenna) construction are covered in this topic, such as the efficiency of the reception antenna, the efficiency of the conversion, the size, the characteristics of the sustaining substrates, the available bandwidth, and the overall quality, etc. The rectenna was designed using conventional antennas. These antennas, which exhibit poor energy conversion efficiency, especially as the size grows, include slot antennas, microstrip antennas, frequency-reconfigurable antennas, coplanar antennas, and others. EH collectors frequently utilize meta-surfaces and meta-material structures to overcome the abovementioned issues, increase conversion efficiency, and achieve a smaller size.

articleTitle: An Innovative Hierarchical P2P Method for Energy Trading Management in A Distribution Network with Micro-Grids
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the idea of a small grid distribution system that gives the public a new framework for controlling and operating these types of grids in the future. By distributing energy resources across numerous partners, it intends to increase the advantages of the conventional small grid. In the micro-grid distribution system of the future society, the peer-to-peer (P2P) energy trading model seems to be one feasible paradigm for energy trading. This paper suggests a three-step peer-to-peer (P2P) regulatory framework for future community microgrid distribution networks to provide efficient energy trading in the microgrid energy market. A community's remote network distribution system is an example of the proposed P2P framework. A simulation analysis has confirmed its usefulness since it reduces costs and congestion on the leading network.

articleTitle: Sign Language Translating into Speech Using Cost-Effective Glove and Smartphone Application for Deaf People
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Communication “is a process of formation and exchange of information, ideas, views, feelings, facts, etc.,” is fundamental to living and surviving among people to arrive at a public understanding. Implementing communication, ensuring its occurrence, and protecting it is essential to human rights. The mobile phone is the best communication tool, but our ears are the most crucial. Listening is the effective key to communication. Better hearing allows people to participate in their communities by succeeding in school, getting good jobs, etc. an integrated smart glove with Arduino and smartphones have been designed. In this paper, Particular motions and signs used by people worldwide who are deaf are used and sent to the smart glove linked to the phone by Bluetooth. Better hearing allows people to participate in their communities by succeeding in school, getting good jobs, etc. By addressing hearing loss, people can promote greater educational attainment and higher levels of economic productivity. Thus, to guarantee that disadvantaged people can receive the hearing look after they need, this work would ease people's life, providing them with better facilities. It will give adequate information to get a better conversation understanding.

articleTitle: Face Mask Detection During COVID-19 Pandemic Using NASNetMobile and CNN Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: The coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic has led to a health, economic, and social crisis, resulting in many casualties and disrupting daily life, trade, and global movements. The most common transmission mode of infection is through respiratory droplets loaded with viruses. They are transmitted during speaking, coughing, or exhaling when people are close to each other and without protection covering the face. Wearing a face mask is the way to reduce COVID-19 transmission from one person to another in public places praised by the World Health Organization (WHO); manually knowing people wearing a face mask is very difficult, especially in crowded places. This paper aims to build a system based on NASNetMobile and Convolution Neural Network (CNN) Deep Learning Algorithms to capture frames from the webcam in realtime, detect faces, and then classify the face whether it is wearing a mask or not. The system is built starting with training dataset collection, preprocessing dataset, classification model building, evaluation, testing, and model implementation. The accuracy of the model built by the Convolutional Neural Network reached 99.3% when evaluated on the test data, while the model built by the NASNetMobile model architecture reached 99.76%. This system helps monitor crowded places and alerts cases of violations of the laws on wearing a face mask.

articleTitle: Estimation of Radon Contamination Levels and Associated Radiological Risk in Selected Samples of Wheat Grain, Muthanna Province-Iraq
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Radon content levels were carried out in (75) selected samples of wheat grain have been collected from (15) fields in different regions in Muthanna Province, Iraq. The radon measurements were conducted using a CR-39 track detector for three months. Radon concentrations in the samples ranged between (4.12 Bq/m3) and (39.01 Bq/m3) with a mean value of (18.24 Bq/m3). The investigated fields have been divided into two groups depending on the type of irrigation water: groundwater fields and surface water fields. The statistical analysis showed that the groundwater fields pose a higher radon content than the surface water fields. Moreover, the radiological risk has been assessed by calculating the annual effective dose received by the public. The results are within the range of (0.224-1.718 mSvy-1), with a mean value of (0.575 mSvy-1). The results revealed that the investigated samples pose radon levels lower than the allowed values reported by the World Health Organization.

articleTitle: A New Hybrid Gorilla Troops Optimizer with Beta Method for Maximum Power Point Tracking of Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: The low efficiency of photovoltaic systems results from the nonlinear characteristic curve, which demands the employment of maximum power point tracking (MPPT) methods. Numerous approaches, such as the conventional approach, have been proposed despite their low cost and ease of implementation. However, these methods are ineffective in quickly changing atmospheric conditions, resulting in power losses. This paper proposed a novel hybrid MPPT controller that combines a Beta method with a gorilla troop optimization technique to overcome these issues and get the maximum power point. For the simulation of LR5-72HPH-535M PV modules, MATLAB/Simulink(R2021a) was utilized. The performance of the proposed Beta _GTO controller was tested and compared to other algorithms such as FGTO, the single structure (PID)controller based on GTO, P&O, and IC under static and dynamic conditions. The quadratic boost converter provides a high step-up function with a low duty cycle ratio. In addition, simulations have demonstrated that the proposed system quickly responds to changing atmospheric conditions. The proposed system's maximum power point tracking efficiency is 99.9 % in a steady state.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Two Adaptive Thresholds Based on Covariance Absolute Value (ITATCAV)
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: The problem of the spectrum is scarcity, and to solve it, cognitive radio was used. The main component of cognitive radio is the sensing of the spectrum. There are several ways to know the sensitivity of the spectrum, each of which has its advantages and disadvantages. In this paper, we improve the method of Two Adaptive Thresholds based on the Covariance Matrix (TATCAV) by reducing the overlap between the licensed user and the unlicensed user. The outcomes of the simulations with Matlab 2021b demonstrate an improvement in the detection probability values. Where the value of = 99.72% at smoothing factor L=2 and constant false alarm rate (CFAR)for the proposed method, and =95.2 for TTCAV when L = 8 and = 0.1, = 0.5, both at SNR=-17 under noise uncertainty = 2 dB, Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN), and Binary Phase Shift Keying modulation BPSK. According to the simulation, the results are better after using the proposed techniques.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Energy Harvesting System Based on Piezoelectric Element
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Due to the massive demand for energy worldwide, many researchers are starting a deep investigation into the issue. So, this paper deals with generating electric power by converting mechanical waste vibration into electric power by attaching a suitable piezoelectric element to a metallic cantilever beam attached to a mechanical engine. The second aim is to use this harvested energy to power Internet of Things (loT) technology. The experimental rig consists of three rectification models: Half Wave Rectifier (HWR), Full Wave Rectifier (FWR), and Cascade Capacitor Rectifier (CCR). These three circuits were built with three different diodes: silicon diode (1N4007), germanium diode (1N60), and Shockley diode (1N5819). The gained practical result showed that after 30 seconds of charging, the associated voltage from the first rectifier was 3 volts, 3.45 volts, and 3.55 volts, with 1N4007, 1N60, and 1N5819, respectively. Meanwhile, the second rectifier gave 2.25, 3, and 3.5 volts for the same sequence of three employed diodes. However, the overall situation regarding the third rectification circuit, where the induced voltage was 6, 6.8, and 7 volts in association with the three diodes mentioned above, in other words, the minimum and maximum harvesting voltage were 2.25V (FWR plus 1N4007), and 7 V (CCR plus 1N5819), i.e., the obtained percentage increase is 311%.

articleTitle: Synthetics Power Quality Disturbances Generated by a Mathematical Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: This paper presents power quality disturbances (PQD) as a high-level danger to the power systems network. These disturbances that may occur alone or with others are called complex events. With the developments in modern power systems and the rise in energy demand, nonlinear loads, power electronics devices, and alternative energy resources have been increasingly installed; therefore, the disturbances will appear clearly. To achieve a mathematical model, dealing with the possibility of developing the power quality sector to ensure that companies are equipped with all the necessary data that diagnoses the cause of these problems. This paper proposed and developed new synthetic signal models based on improvements in the control parameters. These improvements include, first, related to the regular class where power quality standards offer a model; second, related to the combinations of simple disturbances considered complex disturbances; and finally, the controllable and independent parameters for each complicated disturbance have been developed. The accuracy of these models helps scientific researchers save time and effort in this important field.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of A Sterilizer Box to Stop the Spread of COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Coronavirus transmission via cough, sneeze or touch causes COVID-19, a highly contagious illness. Proper hand sanitizing is the single most effective way to stop the spread of diseases. This paper aims to build a contactless electronic sterilizing box used for hand sterilizing by using Arduino, an infrared sensor, and a pump. The device also measures other features like ambient temperature and humidity, person height, and heart rate. The device was mounted on the wall and appropriately tested on subjects; the study concludes that the use of indirect hand sterilizing by attracting the person to measure their height or heart rate and force them to sterilize their hands before the test helps to increase the number of persons who sterilize their hand, in other words, to stop the spread of COVID 19.

articleTitle: Noise Detection and Removing in Heart Sound Signals via Nuclear Norm Minimization Problems
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Heart sound is an electric signal affected by some factors during the signal's recording process, which adds unwanted information to the signal. Recently, many studies have been interested in noise removal and signal recovery problems. The first step in signal processing is noise removal; many filters are used and proposed for treating this problem. Here, the Hankel matrix is implemented from a given signal and tries to clean the signal by overcoming unwanted information from the Hankel matrix. The first step is detecting unwanted information by defining a binary operator. This operator is defined under some threshold. The unwanted information replaces by zero, and the wanted information keeping in the estimated matrix. The resulting matrix contains zeros, so the problem is to find a low-rank matrix. Matrix completion is a heuristic NP-hard problem. It is a minimization problem defined by the matrix nuclear norm. In this paper, nuclear norm, and weighted nuclear norm minimization problems are derived to find a low-rank matrix of implemented Hankel matrix from the signal. A Robust Principal Component used to solve a low-rank-sparse matrix finds a low-rank Hankel matrix by solving a minimization problem numerically. The results show that the given methods are efficient in reconstructing and recovering the signals with a rate of more than 96%, with small values of mean square errors.

articleTitle: Using a Tuned Transfer Learning Model to Identify and Localize White Blood Cells
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: White Blood Cells (WBC) are one of the most significant blood cell components. These cells guard against infection-causing organisms like bacteria, viruses, and fungi. There are five distinct types of white blood cells in the human body. These cells have numerous names, including lymphocytes, monocytes, eosinophils, basophils, and neutrophils. An abnormally high or low white blood cell count might result in various diseases. A dataset of 12,500 JPEG images is divided into four WBC classes. These are Eosinophil, Lymphocyte, Monocyte, and Neutrophil classes. Each class contains about 3000 images. The approximate color of the WBC has been determined by selecting a series of images and analyzing the region of interest. The extracted color was employed as a centroid to segment the image using clustering algorithms. The Region of Interest (RoI) bounding boxes have been trimmed to create a new segmented dataset. CNN's Resnet 50 model was utilized for training and obtaining the results. The dataset has been successively divided into 80:20 train: test sets. After 25 epochs, the model's loss = 6.2305e-04, accuracy = 0.98, validation loss = 0.13, validation accuracy = 0.96, and learning rate = 1.0000e-06 were determined. The model can detect, identify WBC types and localize them.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Text Classification Using Artificial Intelligence Models
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: The presented study provides experiments for carrying out empirical studies related to deep learning, especially convolution networks, concerning novel dataset classification (video and audio). The study will utilize the architecture of the text classification problem in the document domain with the datasets related to documents collected from many projects on real document cases. The process of building a new dataset and the existence of such data followed the urgent need that is specialized in educational lectures. Test and evaluate the two new datasets (Audio and Video) with the published dataset Book dataset by using deep learning methods in classification and machine learning algorithms, then compare the Accuracy results for each dataset with both classification methods, which present that new datasets bring better results than Book dataset which are (95% and 90<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) for new datasets and 83% for Book dataset by using Deep learning, in machine learning algorithms the results are (91%, 77%, and 46<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>). Finally, the two classification techniques are used to maximize the benefits of the classification process. In the selection process, the system will choose deep learning for classifying the datasets than using machine learning algorithms.

articleTitle: E-Voting System Using Solana Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Electronic voting methods are gaining popularity in contemporary culture. It has the potential to reduce administrative expenses and enhance voter participation. Electronic voting systems must be lawful, accurate, secure, and convenient when utilized in elections. This paper aims to establish a project to make electoral systems more decentralized and scalable. As functionality increases, it significantly enhances the Proof-of-Work idea embraced by Bitcoin and Ethereum. Through Solana, it will be simple to implement business logic and ensure that it assists in resolving the world's common problems. We used Solana libraries and the Anchor framework to implement our system to provide convenient tools for developing secure Solana programs and rust programming language.

articleTitle: Faster Than Nyquist Rate Signaling for Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: In this paper, we review the beginning of the FTN, its importance in the communication system, and the benefits of using such a system to improve spectral efficiency and maintain the error rate at a good rate. The problems generated by the FTN result from the conversion of pulses from orthogonal to non-orthogonal, thus causing a reduction in the distance between the pulses, which indicates the generation of ISI in the system. The block of the FTN system, the best types of modulation used, and the best types of pulse shaping used to maintain the error rate and reduce the ISI generated in the transmitter, as well as the use of MMSE as the best type of equalization.

articleTitle: Quality Assurance of Facial Recognition Software for Arabic Social Media Celebrities
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: In this study, we developed a system to test the quality assurance of face detection for Arabic celebrities in social media using the Haar detection technique with the OpenCV Python package. In our developed system, we used 64 images to determine and find the quality measures, like the error rate of recognizing faces in the images, by employing various testing methods. Our work resulted in creating a data set called Yasmin Nadia Arabc Social Media Images containing faces for Arabic social media celebrations, which is available for public use on the websites Kaggle and GitHub. The developed system can identify faces with an accuracy rate of more than 90% in most cases.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study between Artificial Neural Networks and Optical Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Artificial intelligence has gained widespread interest from people from all walks of life since the big data era arrived, so artificial neural networks (ANNs) are one of the most important areas of artificial intelligence that have a close relationship and an effective role in diverse artificial intelligence applications, data is loaded between memory and processor during the calculation, which reduces the calculation rate and increases the power consumption. Training artificial neural network parameters take a long time and consume a lot of energy. Therefore, it is necessary to use new neural networks that differ from artificial neural networks, called optical neural networks. Optical neural networks can overcome the above shortcomings. Compared with artificial neural networks, they have obvious advantages such as high speed, high bandwidth, high balanced processing, low latency, and low power consumption. The optical neural network can significantly improve the performance of required tasks by taking advantage of the high-speed characteristics. The study compares artificial neural networks and optical neural networks to train networks by nonlinear activation functions to perform image classification tasks. The Neural networks are trained and tested with the help of the KMNIST dataset. The backward propagation occurs using the backpropagation algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of a Tag Antenna for RFID Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: This paper introduces a meander line printed dipole antenna with a miniaturized size for RFID at 915MHz applications. A fractal geometry based on a third-order Hilbert structure is introduced as a matching circuit to overcome the impedance-matching limitations of printed meander antennas. Next, the proposed meander structure is introduced to increase the electrical length within a limited substrate size. Such technology supports size reduction. However, the induction current's effects are augmented due to the meander turns. Therefore, introducing the Hilbert fractal curve realizes a capacitive effect, significantly reducing the induction effects. For this, the radiation losses due to the inductive part are canceled ultimately by the capacitive parts induced by the fractal structure. This acquires to keep the resonance frequency at 915MHz with maximum radiation efficiency to get a realized gain of 1.46dBi with a radiation efficiency of 90%. A parametric study supports the design methodology to monitor the effects of varying the antenna dimensions on S11 and Z11 spectrums. The antenna radiation pattern at the desired frequency band (915Mhz) is presented in 3D to observe an omnidirectional pattern. Finally, it is found that the proposed antenna is very suitable for the applications of RFID systems within a moderate communication distance of 5.07 m.

articleTitle: Graph Compression Using CAE Base of PC and K-NN Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: The deep learning neural network has been used to compress, reorganize, and save images and data of different sizes. However, it has several problems, the most important of which is that it takes a long time to encode and uses a lot of bytes. Because of these problems, the neural network isn't good at compressing data. The deep convolutional autoencoder is one of the most important deep learning techniques for lossy compression. This paper talks about a combination of deep learning techniques for the deep neural network and unsupervised machine learning techniques. This combination helped the neural network convolutional autoencoder (CAE) solve the problem of the time it took to encode data and save compressed data from being used. It also helped the unsupervised machine learning algorithm (K-Mean) work well with deep learning. Use this mixing system to compress sets and different sizes of graphs, as the hybrid system got good results in both compression and retrieval (decompression). In contrast, this system uses the clustering feature of the (k-mean) algorithm to compress data and keep the bytes for them within clusters before going into the autoencoder deep learning system, which has multiple layers that help compress and re-decompress the data. This mixing system is unique because it saves the most bytes during the data retrieval (decompression) process and works quickly. Also, the system got good results for the PSNR quality coefficient and the compression rate (CR). For example, for the graphic data set, the system got a PSNR quality coefficient of up to (41.823) and a compression ratio of up to (0.0732).

articleTitle: Design of FOPID Controller for DC Motor Speed Control Using Intelligent Swarm Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: In this paper, the study focuses on the fuzzy-fractional order proportional integral derivative controller to speed controlling the direct current motor. This controller contains five parameters, which are tuned using Particle Swarm Optimization and Ant Colony Optimization algorithms. The proposed controller was compared with the Fractional-Order Controller based on the two optimization techniques. The simulation outputs revealed that the proposed controller outperformed the other controllers, and an improvement in system response, performance, and robustness was also achieved where the settling time, maximum overshoot, rise time, and steady-state error were optimized and reduced according to the results obtained (0.499%, 0.0128sec, 0.0235sec, 0) respectively.

articleTitle: A New 4D Hyperchaotic System with Hybrid Synchronization
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: In this paper, finding two positive Lyapunov exponents (LEs) with the greatest Lyapunov exponents is much more inspiring, vital, and challenging in n-dimensional systems than in other conventional systems. Using a state feedback controller, a novel four-dimensional system with two positive Lyapunov exponents was created and constructed from the well-known Lorenz-like system. The novel 4D chaotic system possesses rich, dynamic properties, such as self-excited attractors and coexisting attractors. The mathematical characteristics of the hyperchaotic system are discussed, analytically and numerically, such as equilibria, Jacobian matrix, phase portraits, Lyapunov exponents, and Hybrid Synchronization. The novel system outperforms the well-known 3D Lorenz-like system. It may be employed in various applications such as neural networks, electrical circuits, biology, and chemical reactions thanks to its self-excited attractor and excellent efficiency, as shown by the Routh-Hurwitz criterion for stability and the Wolf algorithm.

articleTitle: Detection and Counting of Olive Trees in Images Taken by an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles are speedily improving and taking part in remote sensing applications. Precision agriculture applications aim to increase yield and profitability without wasting limited resources and challenging climate change. Olive tree detection and counting is a precision agriculture application. It helps estimate production yield. In this study, the olive tree images were taken with a camera mounted on an unmanned aerial vehicle. Image analysis techniques were implemented to extract and specify the olive tree crown in a few stages. Firstly, uneven illumination was corrected to get uniform light distribution in the image. The next standard deviation filter was utilized to obtain the olive tree boundaries. Following morphological filling to remove discontinuities in the image, the circular Hough transform was employed to detect circular objects. Finally, the detected circular objects were counted automatically. This approach is straightforward, fast, and effortlessly carried out with direct steps. It can beat a few difficulties, like unbalanced light distribution due to natural conditions, time consumption, and many overlapped trees. This technique shows high detection and counting rate for the delineation, detection, and counting of olive trees. The true-positive rate and precision were 94% and 95% on average for test images.

articleTitle: IoT System Based on Iris Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: The Internet of Things is increasingly accessible on the World Wide Web, and WoT provides a new space that makes managing things very easy. The fields of the Internet of Things and because of its many possibilities have been applied very widely in the manufacture and areas of our daily lives. In this paper, it was proposed to use irises to increase data security. The client implements a preprocessing process that consists of the following steps: the first step is to convert color images to the gray level luminosity algorithm, the second step blurring the images by using the median filter algorithm, and step three the images convert to converted to binary images according to a threshold, step four detects the edges by using contour algorithm, and finally resizing the images by using the bilinear interpolation algorithm. The Server cloud side consists of the following steps: the first step is the features extraction which will be used in the sift algorithm to increase the accuracy. The second step uses the eliminated structure of the image and the arrangement of features in the image. The third step uses the k-mean algorithm to extract the algorithm, the fourth step is the classification that uses the algorithm j48, and the algorithm naive Bayes. The Iris recognition dataset is used to evaluate this system, which is the MMU dataset consisting of 450 images of 46 people. The recognition rate for a dataset is 99.99%.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligent Management for Internet of Things: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Nowadays, advances in communication technologies and information processing have formed the Internet of Things. The Internet of Things (IoT) is a technology that is used to send and receive the data of sensors by the use of the internet. The Internet of Things concept has developed in new fields of technology. Because the rapid developments of data carry novel challenges for IoT, the data is a huge artificial intelligence with Internet of Things systems that make managing these data more efficient to store them on the internet of things and protect it from intruders. Combining internet of thing technology with intelligent management has significant study in different areas. Machine learning and fuzzy logic are the most widely used in a broad application of the Internet of Things. This paper introduces the developments of artificial intelligence (AI) and the Internet of Things (IoT). Also, this study highlights the challenges of using artificial intelligence in the IoT that address difficulties for different applications. This article displays the meaning and importance of artificial intelligence and some applications and benefits of artificial intelligence and the Internet of Things. Also, we show the related works of AI and IoT. In the future, it was found through previous studies that the integration of artificial intelligence with the Internet of Things can be used in many areas, in addition to protecting data and institutions from hackers and natural disasters such as fire, flood, theft, etc. via security methods and techniques of artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Diagnose and Analyze Power System Faults Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: The increase in demand for energy increases the complexity of energy systems every day because of the increase in electricity consumption. Complex electrical energy systems consist of many equipment and parts from generation, transmission and distribution, and many power and generation systems do not increase at the same rate required for consumption and are vulnerable to damage in this paper, the major priority is on modern methods of detection, classification and analysis of many kinds of faults in electrical power systems, using machine learning algorithms, using Python and a library scikit-learn, which provides algorithms for supervised machine learning, data is processed using data science offices NumPy, pandas and matplotlib, and the detection and classification data is evaluated using 9 types of algorithms that are available in machine learning which are Support vector machine (SVMs), Logistics regression, Linear regression, Polynomial regression, Random Forest (RF), k-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), (MLP) Multi-layer perceptron, Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, as well as all models they were compared and to be able to determine the best models which was created by the algorithms.

articleTitle: Cryptocurrencies in Blockchains Environment: The Verification Trip
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: A peer-to-peer network called a blockchain, a secure ledger of transactions, such as buying, selling, and transferring, is in charge of organizing and managing the Cryptocurrencies. In contrast with physical money, they are decentralized, which implies neither governments nor other financial organizations issue them. In a cryptocurrency blockchain, transaction data is permanently preserved. A block contains some or all of the most recent transactions the network still needs to confirm. The block is closed once the data has been confirmed. A series of verifications are applied to the transactions that blockchain participants submit to ensure their integrity and for most network security standards to be met. In this paper, we will discuss a set of them.

articleTitle: Facial Action Unit-Based Deepfake Video Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Deepfake videos are becoming more realistic, making them a menace. As a result of the development of deep learning techniques such as Generative adversarial networks (GAN), Deepfake has become closer to the truth. Widespread use of falsified videos and images on social media requires accurate detection. An identity switch (DeepFake) and an expression swap create facial modifications. This paper can detect deepfakes that are perfectly created. Traditional detection approaches that observe artifacts and pixel irregularities cannot keep up with modern technology. The paper is divided into two stages. In the first stage, the paper extracts facial action units from a person and creates a profile for him. This profile represents the behavior of his facial expressions, which differ from one person to another. This was done by building a deep learning network and training it based on a dataset. The second stage is testing, which involves taking videos, extracting facial action units, and testing them on the network to classify them as fake or real. The network has proven its ability to classify with high accuracy of %95.75 compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques in Service of COVID-19: Data Augmentation Based on Multi-Exposure Image FusionTowards Anomaly Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: SARS-CoV-2, the novel coronavirus that causes COVID-19, has wreaked havoc worldwide, with patients displaying a wide range of difficulties that have prompted healthcare professionals to look for innovative technology solutions and treatment methods. The COVID-19 problem is better understood and managed thanks to machine learning approaches. Machine learning enables computers to mimic human intelligence and digest massive volumes of data to identify patterns and insights quickly. In the fight against COVID-19, organizations have been quick to use machine-learning skills in various ways, including enhancing consumer messaging, better understanding how COVID-19 spreads, and accelerating research and treatment. In this study, we aim to use deep learning techniques to predict COVID-19-affected people. A data augmentation stage is taken into consideration based on multi-exposure image fusion. Our dataset consists of chest X-ray images of COVID-19-afflicted persons and ordinary people.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Impact of a Nanoparticle's Sizing on the Effectiveness of Solar Collector Based on Nanofluids
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Improving the thermal efficiency of flat-plate solar collectors increases the thermal energy that is saved. Using a nanofluid instead of a base fluid enhances thermal performance. To evaluate the thermal performance of nanofluid in a solar collector by adding nanoparticles and their influence, such as particle shape, particle sizes, and particle concentration on thermal properties. This study explored the effect of silicon dioxide (SiO2) nanoparticle size on these parameters on the thermal performance of an experimental flat plate solar collector. The investigation of the effect of particle sizes on collector efficiency is a highlight of this study. It is observed that decreasing the size of the nanoparticles results in the enhancement of the efficiency of the flat plate solar collector. An experiment was conducted at three nanoparticle sizes (10 nm, 40 nm, and 90 nm), spherical shape, and particle concentration 0.1 % dissolved with distilled water (DW) to produce working fluid homogenous nanofluid. Under Iraqi climate conditions, the test was carried out at different flow rates (10, 15, 20 1/h). ASHRAE Standard No. 93–2010 was utilized to determine the solar collector's thermal effectiveness. The results showed that the maximum efficiency was roughly 73.1, absorbed energy parameter FR <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\tau \alpha)$</tex> increased, and thermal efficiency increased by approximately 12 % compared with distilled water at an increased flow rate at 20 1/h and decreased particle size at 10 nm

articleTitle: Study the Effected of Antenna Type on the Electromagnetic Pulse (EMP) Generation for Drones Neutralize System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Drone use has exploded in recent years due to its ability to stay in the air for extended periods than crewed aircraft, and it's grown ubiquitous in commercial and recreational settings. Still, it's also been employed extensively in military settings to strike targets. The industry of neutralizing abuse (such as drones) is expanding and experimenting with various approaches. High-Power Microwaves (HPM) is one of the most recent and promising developments in the defense field. It is the most advanced and capable tactical ground-based defensive. In this work, two antennas have been used: E-plane Horn antenna and Helical Array Antenna. The model was first simulated using the CST simulation program and then constructed for a real test. In the simulation, we evaluated several factors to compare both antennas. The simulation results for return loss show that the Helical Array antenna has a much smaller value of about -28.25 dB compared to the E-plane Horn antenna, which has a return loss of about -7.16 dB. Thus, the Helical Array antenna is more efficient, in this instance, as it reflects a smaller portion of its input power than the E-plane Horn antenna. The power excitation results at 0.5 W stimulated power show that the accepted power is 0.403 W for the E-plane Horn antenna. In contrast, the accepted power for the Helical Array antenna is 0.4992 W. The outgoing power for the E-plane Horn antenna is 0.096 W, while the outgoing power for the Helical Array antenna is 0.00075 W. The power radiated and the loss in metal is about 0.0076 W. The simulation results show that the Helical Array antenna is more accurate than the E-plane Horn antenna, where the accepted power in Helical Array is close to stimulated power.

articleTitle: Arabic Document Clustering: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Arabic language significance is continuously growing due to economic advancements and the textual content of the Internet nowadays. As Arabic documents become more widely available on the Internet, Arabic document clustering becomes an essential topic in information retrieval and mining. Electronic Arabic documents are growing daily, making a clustering procedure based on humans impractical. Effective and efficient electronic search algorithms are necessary to make clustering easier and more accurate information retrieval possible. The purpose of this work is to provide a thorough examination of the algorithms and strategies utilized for clustering digitized Arabic texts. The paper presents a critical and constructive analysis of existing published literature in Arabic document clustering through summary, classification, analysis, and comparison. It collects the aims of surveys, such as literature organization and evaluation, identifying patterns and trends in the literature, synthesizing literature, identifying research gaps, and recommending new research areas.

articleTitle: Employing An Efficient Technique with Deep Neural Network for Speaker Identification
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: A speaker identification system based on Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC) and a convolutional neural network (CNN) is proposed in this paper. This paper aims to identify speakers using very short time durations (0.5sec and 1sec) of speech utterances. The system proposed consists of three main steps: preprocessing, feature extraction, and classification. Several techniques are applied to the speech data in the preprocessing step to obtain a better speech representation. Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC) are employed in the feature extraction step to extract the intrinsic features of the preprocessed speech and reduce dimension. Finally, a convolutional neural network (CNN) is used for the classification task. Different databases are employed to evaluate the proposed system: SALU-AC, ELSDSR, RA VDESS, and TIMIT. The results obtained by the proposed system are 95.74%, 99.01%, 87.30%, and 88.03% for 1 sec of the SALU-AC, ELSDSR, RAVDESS, and TIMIT databases, respectively. For 0.5sec, the SALU-AC, ELSDSR, RAVDESS, and TIMIT databases obtained 92.57%, 97.45%, 85.26%, and 74.82%, respectively. The system's high performance is due to the combinations of the powerful techniques used in the preprocessing steps, the MFCC algorithm that leads to the substantial features extracted from the speech signal, and the exhaustion search to choose the adequate parameters for the CNN structure.

articleTitle: Laser Additive Manufacturing System Modification for High-Level Entropy Alloys
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: The surface properties of aerospace components and coatings must be excellent throughout various temperatures. Steel, aluminum, copper, and high-level entropy alloys were employed to improve the external features of these components. This research used laser additive manufacturing to create functional high-level entropy alloys on an austenitic stainless-steel baseplate and to measure the influence of the laser parameters and density on the hardness and morphology of the produced alloys aimed at aerospace industries. Microstructure, as well as hardness, were studied as a function of experimental factors, laser power as well as scan speed. The data revealed that the coatings predictably stuck to the baseplate. Next to a preheat temperature of 400 °C, the best processing parameters, including individual alloys with defects of free structures, were 1200-1600W, 8–12 mm/s, and layers consisting of face-centered cubic and body-centered cubic structure phases. The quality, as well as the hardness of the belongings of alloys, were affected via the experimental factors. According to the findings, enhanced laser settings by increasing the preheating temperature increased the performance of alloys with prospective coatings and structural materials.

articleTitle: Big Data Frameworks Issues, Challenges, and Needs
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: Data deluge has already been entered. Data created concurrently by IoT devices and people is referred to as a data deluge. The data flood poses a serious danger to technology but is advantageous to end consumers. Big data is a new trend that companies, sciences, and engineering fields need because all of these fields contain a lot of data that can be used to solve specific problems. The choice to expand into one's own field was made using big data analysis and mining, and this outcome is quite beneficial for doing so. Any firm that engages in big data mining confronts several difficulties, and these difficulties increase the risks associated with decision-making. The notion of big data and data mining is presented in this article along with the data, process, and management-related issues of big data mining. Big data concerns relate to data mining, process challenges to big data, and management issues to the shared element of big data and data mining. We discuss potential concerns and challenges connected to the features of big data in the concluding half of this essay, along with potential solutions. This research article discusses the overall characteristics of big data as well as the current difficulties and constraints in this field. More specifically, it analyses the future course of Big Data research and its future reach.

articleTitle: Detection of Hate Speech on Twitter for Arabic Iraqi Dialect Using Stochastic Gradient Classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: People increasingly use social media platforms to communicate and share information worldwide. However, challenges such as verbal misbehaviors and hate messages have been raised and widely disseminated via social media. In the Arabic region, especially in Iraq, Twitter is one of the most prominent social media platforms that has gained popularity. Consequently, an ethical reason behind this research is to build a system that can distinguish Iraqi hate tweets. This work achieved three contributions. First, a dataset of Iraqi tweets has been collected and annotated; this is the first dataset for hate speech in the Iraqi dialect. Second, an algorithm for distinguishing Arabic tweets from other oriental tweets that use the same Arabic glyph was proposed to represent a new addition to the preprocessing steps for the Arabic NLP area. This algorithm was tested and showed efficiency in detecting Urdu about (0.91), Persian (0.73), and Arabic (0.98). Third, the Iraqi hate speech classifier was built using two types of text features depending on the stochastic gradient classifier. The classifier was compared with various machine learning algorithms like SVM logistic regression. The proposed system with stochastic gradient classifier was more efficient than other classifiers achieving precision and recall of 0.80.

articleTitle: A Review of Traffic Highway Noise Towards Residential Area
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: The transport technology is developing rapidly in this era; due to this condition, the number of vehicles kept increasing, causing traffic noise or noise pollution (unpleasant, uncomfortable, and frequently loud). The places affected by this heavy noise are the residential areas, educational areas, or facilities close to the highway. Continuous exposure to excessive noise levels may result in psychological and physiological concerns such as hearing damage, hypertension, cardiovascular disease, discomfort, and sleep irritation. This paper reviews the causes of traffic noise, sources of highway noise, propagation of highway traffic noise, its effect on the residential area, and prediction and reduction of traffic noise. The findings proved that highway traffic noise is a severe problem in many places worldwide, which must be considered in the future. As a result, the positioning of buildings, roads, pathways, and urban infrastructure, must all be considered. This study contributes to a review of the influence of noise, highlighting the necessity of dealing with noise pollution in critical areas.

articleTitle: Effect of Partial Optically Filtered Optoelectronic Feedback on Laser Diode Chaotic Emission
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Current Research in Engineering and Science Applications (ICCRESA)
abstract: This experimental study investigates a laser diode dynamic with a large external cavity under a novel technique. Optoelectronic feedback contributes to the optically filtered feedback subject to strength variation by a sensor. This temperature sensor has selected Bragg wavelengths that satisfy wide filtering. This mixing between sensors and communications is a very challenging topic. Two FBGs have experimented; their types differ in FBG active region number, such that they have three and four regions. Results indicate the achievement of various kinds of chaotic signals and spikes. These chaotic signals include strange attractors and large enough chaotic bandwidths. The measured FWHM is changed periodically between two values; 0.25-0.7 kHz versus the bias voltage. This variation manner is changed as a function of the sensor region number. This means that the effect of optical filtering gives a direct response to chaotic laser emission. In the same situation, when optoelectronic feedback is tuned, laser threshold reduction is also observed to indicate good alignment. The two later observations provide evidence for the interplay between these two types of feedback in such a system for applying high-security optical communication and laser networks.
